definition: No meaningful next-7-day instability under the enhanced label rule.
Mild but meaningful instability, including 50 bps close deviation or persistent lower-grade deviation.
Large, persistent, or operationally meaningful instability, including strict sustained depeg, 100 bps close deviation, repeated 50 bps hours, or high average absolute deviation.
Absolute hourly close deviation >= 100 bps for at least 3 consecutive hours.
